notes.title: Battle Axe 1.1 - Casual Mode Update & 75% off!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We recently launched an update for Battle Axe that includes the following changes:

[previewyoutube=lFzIDMTv0kI;full][/previewyoutube]

[olist]
[*] [b]New Casual Difficulty Mode[/b]. Access it from the options menu.
[*] [b]Auto fire! [/b]Hold the ranged attack button to move and shoot, making it easier to strafe and navigate combat. Iolo does not have the ability to move and shoot but can now easily 360 aim around him.
[*][b] Improved CRT shader.[/b]
[*] [b]Other game re-balances. [/b]
These include changes to enemy placement & spawns, stage hazards, frequency of stronger item drops.
[/olist]

If you've been on the fence about trying Battle Axe it's a great time to jump in, as we're just about to have a 75% offer from December 22nd as part of the Winter Sale.

We hope you enjoy!
